source_registry.epistemic_note: Source registry placenta + milk + SCOBY branch is unverified, nonoperational and restricted to ethics-reviewed institutional handling. SCOBY microbial biofilm is not mammalian placenta.

fixed_target_order.protein: Cellulose synthase operon protein D, AcsD
fixed_target_order.structural_test: Obtain monomer confidence only. Known function involves AcsD octamer; monomer prediction alone is insufficient to reproduce pore structure, eight-chain complex, cellulose extrusion, or microbial behavior.

fixed_target_order.protein: Human fibronectin FN1 type-II repeats 1 and 2 collagen-binding region fragment
fixed_target_order.structural_test: Predict isolated two type-II modules, not full FN1, native ECM, placenta, collagen complex, bacterial cellulose binding, matrix mechanics or tissue biocompatibility. Region includes interdomain linker and disulfides may matter.

endpoint_outputs.comparison: AcsD and FN1 are functionally unrelated. Absolute confidence scores not to be compared as efficacy, binding, or stability performance.

hypotheses_and_decisive_limits.H1: AcsD monomer can be structurally modeled by Rowan Boltz2; reference crystal structure is an octamer and needs oligomeric evaluation before any pore or cellulose assembly claim.
hypotheses_and_decisive_limits.H2: A finite FN1 collagen-binding-domain segment can be structurally modeled; native placental ECM behavior cannot be inferred from this isolated generic human protein fragment.
hypotheses_and_decisive_limits.H3: There is no shared biological interaction asserted between bacterial AcsD and human FN1 by this protocol.
